svg.title: Where each part of the agent loop lives
svg.desc: Your request enters the harness. The harness asks the model, which runs on the model company's computers. Tools run in the sandbox, and the result returns to the harness.
svg.text: You
Your computer. The process is your terminal, your editor, or a browser tab.
You ask for a test that rejects an empty password on the login form.
your request
Harness environment
The harness process. It keeps the transcript,
holds the credential that calls the model,
and chooses the next step.
Laptop: this process is your user session,
outside the room where the shell runs.
Cloud: this process is the vendor's workflow
service, on a different computer from the sandbox.
Cursor keeps the loop in that service.
The model
The model company's computers.
A process there writes the next reply.
The reply is a message for you,
or a request that names a tool
and fills in its arguments.
The harness waits on this call.
The sandbox stays quiet until
a tool request comes back.
prompt
reply
tool request
result
Sandbox environment
The tool's process. It reads the login form, edits the test file, and runs the test.
The room holds the project files, the compilers, and the secrets the tests read.
Laptop: a restricted process on your computer. A rule hides the rest of
the computer from the shell. Codex and Claude Code do this.
Cloud: a separate virtual machine. Cursor gives each cloud agent a small
machine with an operating system of its own.
The loop is the harness asking the model, the model asking for a tool, and the tool running in the sandbox.
One request from you can travel that circle many times before the model writes you a message.
File tools in Claude Code run inside the harness process, under path rules. The shell, which can do more, runs in the sandbox.
